title: I am doing and I do (present continuous and present simple)
summary: Сравнение: **present continuous** — действие происходит сейчас, **present simple** — привычка или общий факт; глаголы like, want, know в continuous не используются.
ru:
## Две формы — два смысла
В русском обе ситуации звучат одинаково («Я работаю»), а в английском нужно выбрать.

**Present continuous (am / is / are + -ing)** — **сейчас**, в момент речи.
> Please be quiet. I'**m working**. — Тише, я (сейчас) работаю.
> Tom **is having** a shower at the moment. — Том сейчас принимает душ.
> Take an umbrella. It'**s raining**. — Возьми зонт. Идёт дождь.

**Present simple (I do)** — **вообще**, всегда или регулярно.
> I **work** every day from 9 to 5.30. — Я работаю каждый день с 9 до 5.30.
> Tom **has** a shower every morning. — Том принимает душ каждое утро.
> It **rains** a lot in winter. — Зимой часто идут дожди.

## Сигнальные слова
- **continuous**: now, at the moment, today, Look!, Listen!
- **simple**: always, usually, often, sometimes, never, every day, at weekends

## Сравните
> Jim **plays** the guitar. (он умеет и часто играет) → Jim **is playing** the guitar now. (играет сейчас)
> **Does** he play the guitar? — Yes, he does. · **Is** he playing the guitar? — No, he isn't.

## Глаголы, которые не используем в continuous
Глаголы состояния, чувств и мнений обычно стоят **только в present simple**:
**like, love, hate, want, need, prefer, know, understand, remember, forget, believe, mean**
> I'm tired. I **want** to go home. (не ~~I'm wanting~~)
> Do you **know** that girl? — Yes, but I don't **remember** her name.
> I don't **understand**. What do you **mean**?

## Типичные ошибки
- ~~Please be quiet. I work.~~ → I'**m working**.
- ~~Tom has a shower now.~~ → Tom **is having** a shower now.
- ~~I am liking this music.~~ → I **like** this music.
- ~~I'm knowing the answer.~~ → I **know** the answer.
- ~~What do you do now?~~ → What **are you doing** now?
en:
## Two forms, two meanings
**Present continuous (am / is / are + -ing)** — something is happening **now**.
> Please be quiet. I'**m working**.
> Tom **is having** a shower at the moment.
> Take an umbrella. It'**s raining**.

**Present simple (I do)** — things that are true **in general**, or happen **always / regularly**.
> I **work** every day from 9 to 5.30.
> Tom **has** a shower every morning.
> It **rains** a lot in winter.

## Time words
- **continuous**: now, at the moment, today, Look!, Listen!
- **simple**: always, usually, often, sometimes, never, every day, at weekends

## Compare
> Jim **plays** the guitar. → Jim **is playing** the guitar now.
> **Does** he play the guitar? — Yes, he does. · **Is** he playing the guitar? — No, he isn't.

## Verbs we don't use in the continuous
Use only the present simple with:
**like, love, hate, want, need, prefer, know, understand, remember, forget, believe, mean**
> I'm tired. I **want** to go home. (not ~~I'm wanting~~)
> I don't **understand**. What do you **mean**?

## Common mistakes
- ~~Please be quiet. I work.~~ → I'**m working**.
- ~~I am liking this music.~~ → I **like** this music.
- ~~What do you do now?~~ → What **are you doing** now?
structure:
## Сравнение форм
| | Present continuous | Present simple |
|---|---|---|
| Утверждение | I am working. | I work. / He works. |
| Отрицание | I'm not working. / He isn't working. | I don't work. / He doesn't work. |
| Вопрос | Are you working? | Do you work? / Does he work? |
| Краткий ответ | Yes, I am. / No, he isn't. | Yes, I do. / No, he doesn't. |
| Смысл | сейчас, в этот период | всегда, обычно, вообще |

## Сигнальные слова
| Continuous | Simple |
|---|---|
| now, at the moment, today, Look!, Listen! | always, usually, often, sometimes, never, every day |

## Формулы
> **am / is / are + -ing** → She **is reading** now.
> **глагол (+ s с he/she/it)** → She **reads** every evening.

## Глаголы только для present simple
| Чувства | Мнения / знания | Потребности |
|---|---|---|
| like, love, hate, prefer | know, understand, remember, forget, believe, mean | want, need |

> ~~I'm wanting a coffee.~~ → I **want** a coffee.
> ~~She is knowing the answer.~~ → She **knows** the answer.

exercises.title: Сейчас или всегда?
exercises.instruction: Поставьте глагол в скобках в present continuous или present simple.

items.text: Please be quiet. I {{am working|'m working}}.
I {{work}} every day from nine to five.
Tom {{is having|'s having}} a shower at the moment.
It {{rains}} a lot in winter here.
She {{doesn't watch|does not watch}} TV very often.
Why {{are}} you wearing a coat? It's not cold.

exercises.title: Продолжите ответы
exercises.instruction: Ответьте на вопросы про Джима (Jim играет на гитаре, но сейчас смотрит телевизор).

items.text: Does Jim play the guitar? — Yes, he {{does}}.
Is Jim playing the guitar now? — No, he {{isn't|is not}}.
Is Jim watching TV now? — Yes, he {{is}}.
Does Jim often watch TV? — Yes, he {{does}}.
Are you reading this now? — Yes, I {{am}}.

items.why: Постоянная работа → present simple, he → works.

items.q: I ___ the answer. Can you help me?
I ___ tea. Can I have coffee, please?
Как сказать «Он обычно ездит на автобусе»?
options: He is usually going by bus.

exercises.title: Ответьте на вопросы
exercises.instruction: Эльза работает в кафе, и прямо сейчас она готовит кофе. Ответьте кратко на вопросы.

items.prompt: Does Elsa work in a café? (Yes, ...)
Is Elsa cleaning a window now? (No, ...)
What is Elsa doing now? (make / coffee)

exercises.title: Переведите на английский
exercises.instruction: Переведите. Выберите present simple или present continuous.

answers: He is having a shower now.
Now he is having a shower.
She has a shower every morning.
She has a shower every day in the morning.
I do not understand this question.
I do not understand the question.

exercises.title: Напишите о себе
exercises.instruction: Ответьте полными предложениями. Проверьте по образцу.

items.sample: I drink tea and go to work every morning.

items.prompt: Что вы не понимаете в английском? (use: I don't understand ...)
